findings.observed: in the full battery (but not in isolation), the evidence-bundle reproduce test failed: Evidence.canonicalSha(regenerate()) != the committed claims.bundleSha
findings.rootCause: canonicalSha stringified the frozen-paths LIST order-sensitively; under the full-battery module-load path Object.keys(FROZEN_PY) surfaced a different (alphabetical vs declaration) order, so a semantically-identical bundle hashed differently — the `verify` reproducibility was test-order-fragile. No frozen byte moved; the ordering was incidental.
findings.fix: FROZEN_PATHS is now SORTED (the path order is a SET, semantically irrelevant) so the canonical sha is order-INDEPENDENT and `verify` reproduces regardless of module-load ordering. The bundle sha re-pinned to the stable value; PINS_SHA unchanged (the bundle is a regenerable artifact, not a pin).
findings.retest: S14 green in the full battery + in isolation; two consecutive clean runs 511/0 identical; ./organon.sh verify GREEN

findings.observed: the counterparty screen leaked raw age/size numbers ($240.0M, 900d) into the PLAIN (Simple) register — a depositor reads words, not stats
findings.rootCause: counterpartyScreenRow embedded the numeric age/size in its plainReason; the plain register is meant to be qualitative (the numbers belong in the row VALUE / the Pro register — X-ONE)
findings.fix: the counterparty plain reasons are now QUALITATIVE ('mature and well-sized', 'young and dust-sized'); the age/size numbers live only in the row value (the Pro register). The caveat + no-over-claim invariants are unchanged.
findings.retest: E.0 depositor green (no raw decimals in any plain register); honesty_counterparty green (caveat + no over-claim hold)
